frase_gancho.texto: The largest and most imposing ball court in all of Mesoamerica.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: To the northwest of the plaza stands the Great Ball Court, the largest known in Mesoamerica. There are four stops. First, the court itself, with its stone rings set at great height, which are interpreted as portals to the underworld. Then the panels of the benches, with a scene of decapitation repeated six times. Next come the North and South Temples, at the ends of the court, and finally the Temple of the Jaguars, with its two levels, one above the other. More than a sport, this place seems to have had a ritual meaning, and its details are still being studied.
